operands.name: rd
operands.description: old value (and compare value for AMCAS)

experiments.name: two-atomic dependency cycle
experiments.notes: Two atomics alternate rd/rk; per-instruction latency = core_cycles / 2.

latencies.notes: Nominal 16-cycle atomic latency. Measured values converge to 16 ± 0.03 cycles; increasing unroll above 1000 does not remove the residual, so it is measurement/coherence noise rather than call overhead.

notes: Atomic memory operation. Latency/throughput are nominally 13 cycles (16 for _db variants). Repeated measurements at unroll 1,000–1,000,000 converge to these values with about ±0.03 cycle noise.
